executionBoundary: manual Logic Pro project and native Project or Section bounces; no TrackSmith authority to inspect, insert, alter, or automate Logic is established
modelContextSummary: Bounded direct Logic Pro 12.3 build-6674 evidence at 48 kHz records corrected Audio 2 clean-path Adaptive Limiter header-bypass source mapping in both stereo one-sided directions, one active +6 dB/-1 dB/20 ms/DC-off/true-peak-off state, exact settled repeats, right-only save/reload recovery, and deterministic vocal-, guitar-, and bass-like fixtures. The run remains partial: it does not characterize the full gain/ceiling/lookahead/DC/true-peak grid, private topology, sample-rate or routing behavior, perceptual quality, or TrackSmith control authority.

nativeState.nativeStateBoundary: The stated controls are direct observations of the recorded Logic state only; they do not identify Apple's private limiter topology or establish behavior for unrecorded settings.

renderMethod.settlingRule: Retain each first-transition render, then require pairwise decoded PCM byte identity across r1, r2, and r3 before describing a settled recorded state.
renderMethod.analysisRule: All channel/gain/lag figures are objective file and signal measurements from the named JSON reports; no listener claim is derived from them.

documented_default_and_bypass_path.evidence: Corrected Audio 2 true-stereo header-bypass renders map left-only and right-only source channels exactly, while the native editor records one active +6 dB, -1 dB ceiling, 20 ms lookahead, DC-off, true-peak-off state.

every_discrete_mode_model_algorithm_and_.evidence: The admitted run records one corrected Audio 2 stereo routing and one visible Adaptive Limiter state; other modes, channel formats, and routing states are unmeasured.

bounded_continuous_parameter_grid_with_i.evidence: Gain, Output Ceiling, Lookahead, Remove DC Offset, and True Peak Detection are verified only at the named active state; retained older and rejected states are not admitted as a parameter grid.

reported_and_measured_latency_polarity_g.evidence: Accepted one-sided settled renders report measured gain, zero-frame lag, exact silent opposite channels, and a -1 dBFS peak on named fixtures. Host latency, tails, and other scheduling regimes were not captured.

three_identical_renders_for_repeatabilit.evidence: Each admitted settled state retains three renders with pairwise decoded-PCM identity; first transitions remain separate provenance artifacts.

save_reload_state_and_source_hash_verifi.evidence: The right-only active state visibly recovered after reload, post-reload repeats are PCM exact, and every named project-media source copy is PCM exact to its run-local fixture.

input_gain_output_ceiling_peak_behavior_.evidence: The admitted active state measured approximately +5 dB source-to-output gain with a -1 dBFS peak and is compared against corrected header bypass; broader gain/ceiling behavior remains open.

lookahead_latency_release_recovery_optim.evidence: One 20 ms Lookahead state produced bounded zero-lag file measurements and settled repeats; release, optimal mode, program dependence, and other lookahead values remain unmeasured.

dc_removal_true_peak_mode_and_external_o.evidence: Remove DC Offset and True Peak Detection were directly observed OFF for the admitted state; no ON comparison or external oversampled peak characterization is claimed.

density_distortion_pumping_stereo_link_m.evidence: Vocal-, guitar-, and bass-like deterministic fixtures retain objective gain, correlation, peak, channel, and repeatability measurements; density, pumping, stereo-link laws, mono translation, and other rates remain open.

measurements.headerBypassTrueStereoOneSided: Both corrected left-only and right-only settled header-bypass lanes are PCM byte exact to their source-mapped output channels and silent opposite channels.
measurements.activeTrueStereoOneSided: The admitted active state records measured one-sided gain near +5 dB, zero-frame lag, exact silent opposite channels, and repeatable settled PCM.
measurements.rightOnlyReload: Post-reload right-only settled renders are pairwise PCM exact and match pre-reload settled output according to the retained comparison reports.
measurements.musicalFixtureSeries: The named deterministic vocal-, guitar-, and bass-like fixture series retains repeatable objective file measurements; no listener result is represented.
measurements.measurementBoundary: Objective decoded-file and signal comparisons describe only the exact recorded states, fixtures, routing, and bounce settings.

measuredBehavior: Corrected Audio 2 header bypass preserves left-only and right-only stereo source mapping in settled renders.

The admitted active state produces repeatable one-sided output with approximately +5 dB measured gain, zero-frame lag, exact opposite-channel silence, and a -1 dBFS peak on the named dynamic fixtures.

inferredConsequences: Typed knowledge must retain the exact Adaptive Limiter control values, source/routing provenance, first-transition versus settled distinction, and decoded-PCM evidence paths.
The corrected clean-path evidence is suitable only for a bounded partial profile and cannot be generalized to the full Adaptive Limiter transfer law.
professionalPracticeHeuristics: Gain, ceiling, lookahead, true-peak mode, release behavior, source density, and delivery targets remain source- and role-dependent decisions requiring level-matched listening.
prohibitedOverclaims: No exact transfer, private topology, universal parameter law, perceptual quality, loudness preference, mono compatibility, or TrackSmith Logic-control authority is claimed.
